# Event Stream Recipes

## The goal

Each recipe here is a small, finished piece of operational tooling for an event
log that is already carrying traffic.

## How this course teaches

Every recipe is independent. Take the one you need; the tutor sets one task at a
time within it.

## What you are assumed to bring

These recipes operate a broker rather than build one. `tutorial.yaml` names the
concepts they assume. No course is required, and nothing here asks what you have
taken before.

## Topics this course must cover

- dead letter handling
- replay tooling
- consumer lag

## Where this course stops

Nothing here writes a broker. These recipes read and operate one.
